caption: The drawing features three greenish-brown glass bottles, all with flattish, flask-like bodies and short necks. The largest bottle is centrally placed at the bottom of the composition; it bears a detailed embossed profile portrait of a man in uniform, oriented to the left, with the text "BRIDGETON NEW JERSEY" arched around the image and a five-pointed star separating the two words. Directly above and slightly to the left of the central bottle is a smaller bottle with a similar flask shape, displaying an embossed profile portrait of a different man facing left, with the word "WASHINGTON" over the portrait. To the right of this smaller bottle, there is another, viewed from the side, showing vertical ribbing along its length, without visible portraits or inscriptions. The background is light cream or beige, and the objects cast slight, diffuse shadows and highlights, emphasizing their glassy texture and reflective quality. The artist's signature, “Chas. C. Sheam,” is on the bottom right corner.
title: Flask
